title: crambe hispanica subsp. glabrata
intro: Crambe hispanica subsp. glabrata, commonly known as Smooth Crambe, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Crambe include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of Crambe hispanica subsp. glabrata include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
